component.name: Vinci Convert
component.summary: Convert videos to DaVinci Resolve compatible formats (ProRes)

description.p: Vinci Convert transcodes videos into DaVinci Resolve friendly ProRes files using ffmpeg. It auto-detects the pixel format and picks the right ProRes profile (HQ, 4444 with alpha, or stream copy), and can export finished edits back to H264 for delivery.

ul.li: Convert single files or whole directories (recursive) to ProRes
Automatic pixel-format detection (422 HQ / 4444 alpha / copy)
Catppuccin Mocha themed desktop app and terminal UI
